data.name: Tanirika
data.gender_notes: Tanirika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tanirika is a Sanskrit name derived from the name of the goddess Tanu. The name signifies the radiance or brilliance of the goddess. In Hindu mythology, Tanu is the wife of King Bhishma and is considered a symbol of purity and grace. The name is also believed to bring blessings of prosperity and good fortune. The name Tanirika carries the meaning “Goddess Tanu's Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Tanirika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess tanu's radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tanirika total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
